card.name: Dosing interval and frequency words
card.fires_on: The word ending a frequency phrase in dosing or monitoring instructions, mostly "hours" after "every 4" or "every 6". Also "weekly" after "monitor liver tests" and "often" in "no less often than".

modes.label: Hours in every-N-hours
modes.description: "hours" closing a dosing interval such as every 4 to 6 hours.
modes.example: 1 teaspoonful (5 mL) every 4 to 6<< hours>>, not to exceed 6 teaspoonsful

modes.label: Monitoring frequency
modes.description: "weekly" or "often" saying how frequently a test or check is done.
modes.example: monitor liver tests<< weekly>> until normalized.
